newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexpetrol sells stake in Argentine project.
newsitem.headline: Mexpetrol sells stake in Argentine project.

text.p: The Mexican company Mexpetrol SA de CV will sell its stake in the Argentine oil project known as El Porton-Buta-Ranquil to the the Argentine companies Yacimientos Petroliferos Fiscales SA and ASTRA, the Mexican state oil company Pemex said on Sunday.
Mexpetrol is a joint veture of government and private capital in which Pemex has a minority interest.
The sale price for the Mexpetrol rights was more than $200 million, Pemex said.
In 1992, Mexpetrol invested in the development and production of the El Porton-Buta-Ranquil oil field, acquiring 33.5 percent of the rights, Pemex said.
The partner companies of Mexpetrol are Empresas ICA, Bufete Industrial, PROTEXA, EPN an IMP.
ASTRA, one of the buying companies, is controlled by the Spanish firm Repsol, Pemex said.
Pemex said its share of the proceeds from the sale would be invested in oil exploration in Mexico.
